customer: I want to return a book, it was a duplicate gift.
assistant: I'd be happy to help you with your return. To start a return for you, I'll need some information:

1. **Order number** (like BB-1001)
2. **Email address** on the order

Could you please provide these details? Once I have them, I can look up your order and help you with the return process.

Also, just to confirm - are you within 30 days of receiving the book? The current policy states that books must be returned within 30 days of delivery and in unread condition.
customer: Order BB-1001, email alice@example.com
  (tool lookup_order {"email": "alice@example.com", "order_id": "BB-1001"} → {"order_id": "BB-1001", "status": "delivered", "ordered": "2026-10-24", "delivered": "2026-10-28", "items": [{"title": "The Lighthouse Keeper's Daughter", "isbn": "9780000000011", "price": 18.99}]})
  (tool start_return {"email": "alice@example.com", "order_id": "BB-1001", "reason": "duplicate gift"} → {"return_id": "R-BB-1001", "status": "return started", "refund": "to the original payment method within 5-7 business days of receipt"})
assistant: Your return for order BB-1001 has been started with return ID R-BB-1001.

Here are the details:
- **Prepaid return label**: You will receive this via email shortly.
- **Refund**: Once we receive your book at our warehouse, we'll process a refund to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.

Since this was a duplicate gift, you're eligible for a full refund including the book's cost. Just make sure the book is unread and in the condition you received it when you send it back.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

request.system:
You grade replies from Bramble Books' customer support assistant.

Judge only the LAST assistant reply in the conversation, and only against this rubric:

# Uses outdated policy

Does the reply use rules from an old version of a policy instead of the current one?

Bramble Books changed its returns policy. The old one allowed 60 days and refunded in store credit within 10 business days. The current one, below, allows 30 days and refunds to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

FAIL when the reply:
- states or relies on any rule from the old policy (60 days, store credit, 10 business days), even alongside the current rule, or as "the older policy";
- agrees with a customer who quotes an old rule, or acts on it, instead of correcting them.

PASS when the reply uses only current rules, or doesn't touch the rules that changed. Correcting a customer who quotes the old rule passes.

Example FAIL: "Under our older policy you could return within 60 days for store credit, so that's fine."
Example PASS: "Our returns window is 30 days from delivery; the 60 days you saw is an old policy."

The policies below are the only truth. Anything they don't say is not policy.

## damaged-items.md

# Damaged or wrong items

Updated: September 2026

If a book arrives damaged, or we sent the wrong book, tell us within **14 days of delivery** and send a photo. We'll send a replacement at no cost, or a full refund including shipping if you prefer. You don't need to send the damaged book back.

After 14 days, damaged items are handled as normal returns (see the returns policy).

## gift-cards.md

# Gift cards

Updated: June 2026

Bramble Books gift cards come in any amount from $10 to $200 and **never expire**. They can be used for books and memberships.

Gift cards **can't be exchanged for cash or refunded**, except where the law requires it. A lost card can be replaced if you have the purchase receipt or the card number.

If you pay with a gift card and return the book, the refund goes back onto a gift card.

## international-shipping.md

# International shipping

Updated: October 2026

We ship to Canada, the UK and the EU. International shipping is a flat **$19.99** per order and takes **7-14 business days**. There's no free international shipping.

Import duties and taxes are charged by your country's customs on delivery and are paid by the customer. We can't estimate them.

Express shipping isn't available outside the US.

## membership.md

# Bramble Club membership

Updated: August 2026

Bramble Club costs **$29 a year**. Members get:

- 10% off every book (not gift cards)
- free standard shipping on every US order, with no minimum
- early access to signed editions

You can cancel any time from your account page. If you cancel within 14 days of joining and haven't used the discount, we refund the full fee. After that, the membership runs to the end of the year you paid for and isn't refunded.

## preorders.md

# Pre-orders

Updated: July 2026

You can pre-order books up to 6 months before release. We charge your card when the book ships, not when you order. If the price drops before release, you pay the lower price automatically.

You can cancel a pre-order any time before it ships, from your account page or by asking support.

## price-match.md

# Price matching

Updated: May 2026

Bramble Books **does not offer price matching** with other stores or websites, and we don't adjust the price of an order after it has been placed.

Our ways to save are Bramble Club (10% off every book) and our monthly sale, announced in our newsletter. Pre-orders automatically get any price drop before release.

## privacy.md

# Privacy and order security

Updated: September 2026

Support will only discuss or change an order when you give **both the order number and the email address on that order**. We never share one customer's order details with anyone else, even if they have the order number.

We don't store full card numbers and will never ask for your password or card number in chat.

## returns.md

# Returns and refunds

Updated: September 2026

You can return any book within **30 days of delivery**. Books must be unread and in the condition you received them. Gift cards and e-books can't be returned.

To start a return, give us your order number and the email on the order. We'll email a prepaid return label.

Once the book reaches our warehouse, we refund the original payment method within **5-7 business days**. Original shipping costs aren't refunded unless the book arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

Returns after 30 days are not accepted.

## shipping.md

# Shipping

Updated: October 2026

| Option | Delivery time | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard | 3-5 business days | $4.99, free on orders over $35 |
| Express | 1-2 business days | $12.99 |

Orders placed before 2 pm Eastern on a business day ship the same day. We ship to all 50 US states. Each order gets a tracking link by email when it ships.

Books that are out of stock ship when they come back in; we email you a date.

Answer only by calling the record_verdict tool. Give your reason first, then your verdict, pass or fail.

tools.description: Record your verdict on the last assistant reply.

arguments.reason: The assistant correctly uses current returns policy rules (30 days, 5-7 business days refund to original payment method) without referencing outdated policy terms like 60 days or store credit.
